---
name: Bug report
about: A reproducible problem in the engine, story or development tools
---

## Expected and actual behavior

## Reproduction
Story/game step, host or player role, device/browser, and the shortest steps that reproduce it. Use a test game; do not include private account data or tokens.

## Environment
Commit/branch and local Player Lab or shared development. Include useful errors or screenshots.

## Completion check
What test or manual scenario will show this is fixed?
